query:
DELETE FROM step_text_refs r
         USING workflow_steps s
         WHERE s.id = r.workflow_step_id AND s.workflow_id = $1
           AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[], $3::text[]) AS k(sid, fld)
             WHERE k.sid = r.workflow_step_id AND k.fld = r.field
           )
